source_acquisition.search_note: PDF 首页/脚注/正文给出 arXiv 2604.06268、OpenReview 01caH9oj7C 和 RAGEN project page；reports/tables/visual_source_inventory.csv 的自动行原为 no_public_source_found，且 corpus/visual_sources/icml-2026-dba55bc31703/ 无本地文件。随后用完整标题/方法名和 authenticated gh API 核查，确认 RAGEN-AI/ragen-ai.github.io 的 project metadata 与 RAGEN-2 对齐，tree/main 含上述 rendered PNG 与 FindingsSection.astro 的嵌入映射。没有找到 plotting script、table generator、TeX/TikZ/PGF、notebook、metric data 或 PDF layout source；fig12_gradient_decomposition.png 是网站扩展视觉，fig9_rv_heatmap.png 仅为 website-only heatmap，均不是额外 PDF 对象。故仅将可视觉匹配的 PNG 记为 rendered_asset，所有数值、页码、caption 和图表清单仍以本地 PDF 为准。

paper_style.palette_strategy: 概念图用浅黄/浅绿/浅粉/浅蓝卡片和黑灰箭头；定量曲线/柱图多用蓝、橙、绿、灰 categorical palette，Figure 12 以 success viridis colorbar 与 RV bubble size 叠加；表格用 booktabs 黑色规则并用 pastel group headers。方法颜色和灰度冗余在同一对象内通常清楚，但跨 Figures 5/6/10/14 未完全冻结，Figure 9 还出现 caption orange 与 rendered blue mismatch。
paper_style.vector_raster_mix: PDF 字体、caption、表格规则和外围文字是嵌入 text/vector；Figures 1、3–12、14 多含嵌入 PNG/JPEG/raster chart，流程框线和部分 labels 仍可作为 PDF 对象读取。全篇为 mixed vector-raster 排版；p.1 的图像资源和 p.7/p.10 等高分辨率 assets 在 pdfimages 中可见。
paper_style.style_consistency: A4 双栏、URWPalladio/数学字体正文与 DejaVu Sans/HelveticaNeue/Aptos 图内标签整体稳定，表格保持 booktabs-like rules，图表 caption 都直接命名标签。主要不一致是小图 caption 对 legend/阴影/aggregation 定义不足、Table 4/5/9 的密集宽表和 Figure 6 环境命名、Figure 9 颜色命名。

figures.label: Figure 2

caption.text: Figure 2: Schematic Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) view of RL updates. Left: total gradient decomposes into task gradient (sharpens with higher within-input reward variance) and regularization gradient. Right: high reward variance yields strong task gradient and better convergence (high SNR); low reward variance makes regularization gradient dominate, producing erratic updates and input-agnostic reasoning (low SNR).

caption.text: Figure 3: Prompts sorted into six equal-sized reward-variance buckets Q1–Q6. We find: (a) Task gradient norm increases monotonically with bucket RV; (b) When RV near 0, substantial task gradients persist despite carrying almost no useful signal; (c) Regularizer gradient norm (KL + entropy) is flat across buckets. This directly supports the SNR mechanism under both algorithms.

figures.label: Figure 4

caption.text: Figure 4: SNR-Aware Filtering workflow. At each training iteration: (1) rollout generation collects trajectories; (2) within-prompt reward variance is computed as SNR proxy; (3) prompts are ranked by RV and top-p fraction retained, policy update performed only on high-signal subset. This filtering loop can prevent updating on noisy rollouts and requires no additional models/rollouts beyond standard RL.

color.semantic_mapping: 浅蓝三卡是操作阶段；绿/黄/红/灰表示 high/medium/low RV、keep/discard 与 update route。

encodings.y: 每步内 prompt/trajectory/ranking 对象层级
encodings.shape: prompt cards, reward bars, histogram, arrows
encodings.line: 流程箭头和 cumulative threshold guide

figures.data_and_statistics: 示意 workflow；histograms 与 reward bars 没有实际单位、样本量、variance estimator 或 P/G 数值。
figures.evidence_relation: Figure 2 SNR decomposition → Figure 4 executable filter interface → §3.3 filtered objective → Tables 4–9 outcomes; Appendix G details Top-p/Top-k/Min-p。
design_strengths: 明确输入、组内统计、排序、阈值和 update mask。
三卡结构可直接改写成实现或复现实验 checklist。
design_weaknesses: top-p cumulative ranking 可能与 reward magnitude 混淆。
没有表达 ties、zero-variance handling、loss scaling 或实际 batch sizes。
figures.reusable_pattern: 用三卡流程同时展示 rollout input、per-group score、selection operator 和 update output。

caption.text: Figure 5: Training dynamics under different intervention strategies. (a) Task success rate, (b) MI proxy (retrieval accuracy), and (c) reasoning entropy. Without filtering, MI degrades early while entropy spikes, signaling template collapse. Filtering effectively mitigates the decline in retrieval accuracy, with top-p SNR-Aware filtering best preserving both task performance and reasoning diversity.

caption.text: Figure 14: Six MI proxy metrics over training steps. (a) MI Estimate, (b) MI Z-Score (EMA), (c) Retrieval Above Chance, (d) Retrieval Accuracy @4, (e) Retrieval Accuracy @8, (f) Conditional Entropy H(Z|X). tables.label: Table 1

caption.text: Table 1: MI proxy family. All variants are derived from in-batch cross-scoring of reasoning traces against prompts, using matched (per-token log-prob under the true prompt) and marginal (per-token log-prob under the uniform prompt mixture) as base quantities. First-turn variants use only the first agent turn; trajectory variants sample across all turns.

tables.uncertainty: 没有均值、误差、区间、重复或样本量；formula 与 notes 是定义性内容。
tables.data_and_statistics: 六种 MI proxy 的 Type/Proxy/Formula/Notes；共同使用 matched/marginal cross-scoring，first-turn 与 trajectory scope 由 notes 区分。
tables.evidence_relation: §2.3 proxy definition → Table 1 → Eq. (1) → Figures 5/8/14 diagnostic choices。
design_strengths: 共同 scoring substrate 和 variant scope 集中可读。
Notes 暴露 first-turn/trajectory 的范围差异。
design_weaknesses: Formula/Notes 多行且字号小。

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Entropy blind spot → Figure 1 two-axis regime → Table 1 MI proxy family → Figure 2/3/Table 2 SNR mechanism → Figure 4 RV/top-p operator → Figures 5–8 and Table 4 main results → Figures 9–13 and Tables 5–8 boundary, cost and mechanism stress tests → Appendix Table 9/Figure 14 failure and proxy completeness.
cross_object_system.caption_system: Caption 以 Figure/Table N: 命名，通常不使用粗体结论标题；Figure 1–5、9、13 和 Tables 1/4/5/9 较自包含，Figures 6/7/10/11/14 与 Tables 2/3 依赖正文。主要结果 caption 会陈述 MI、filter、collapse 方向，但几乎不定义 seed、误差带、聚合、分母或 n。
cross_object_system.table_header_system: 表格使用 booktabs-like 横线和 compact header；Table 4 用 pastel row groups，Table 5 用 NF/F/Δ 的双层 metric groups，Table 9 用三段 block headers。P/G、RV、Traj/Update、✓/✗ 等缩写依赖正文，宽表通过小字号维持页宽。
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Figure 1/Table 1 define construct and proxy；Figure 2/3/Table 2 explain and measure gradient signal/noise；Figure 4 defines the filtering interface；Figure 5/6/Table 4 report headline comparisons；Figures 7–13 and Tables 5–9 test behavior, cost, proxy boundary, granularity, alternative metrics and failures.
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: Main text retains definition, SNR story, selection rule and headline results on p.1–18. Appendix p.24–44 supplies environment/hyperparameters, alternative filters, Table 9, Figure 14 and H–N theorems/proofs; Appendix J bias and H/L assumptions qualify the causal strength of the main visual chain.
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: PDF object font inventory shows URWPalladioL Roman/Bold/Italic for paper text, DejaVu Sans/HelveticaNeue/Aptos for chart labels, XCharter/CambriaMath/tx families for math, and LM Mono for monospaced snippets. Estimated chart text is about 6–8 pt and table/body text about 8–9 pt; family is exact from pdffonts while size/weight within embedded assets are mixed/estimated.
cross_object_system.color_consistency: Blue/green/orange/gray are reused for strategies and metrics, while conceptual figures use pastel role cards. Strategy color+line encodings are often redundant within a figure, but semantics drift between Figures 5, 6, 10 and 14; Table 4/9 group fills are not a quantitative scale. Figure 9 caption calls Top-p orange although rendered bars are blue.

most_reusable_patterns: 二维 conceptual grid 先显式定义 metric blind spot，再让 proxy、mechanism 和 result 共用 MI/entropy vocabulary。
Figure 3 的 rows=algorithm、columns=mechanism component、x=ordered bucket small multiples，使理论链条可逐项证伪。
Figure 4 的三卡 workflow 同时说明 rollout input、per-prompt statistic、ranking threshold、keep set 和 update mask。
Table 4/5/9 用 grouped headers 在一个 decision surface 放入 absolute performance、delta、cost 和 Stable/failure，并在 caption 说明 block baseline。
Figure 9/Table 8 显式呈现 reward-variance proxy 的适用边界，避免把正向结果写成无条件普适。
highest_value_objects: Figure 1：全文 entropy–MI blind spot 与 regime vocabulary 的视觉锚点。
Figure 3 + Table 2：把 SNR claim 连接到 gradient components、PPO/GRPO 和 controllability。
Table 4：跨算法、规模、类型、模态并保留 negative delta 的主 decision surface。
Figure 9 + Table 8：RV proxy boundary 与负效应的可见证据。
Table 9 + Figure 14：appendix 中 alternative/failure/proxy completeness 的最高复现价值对象。
failure_patterns: 主结果图表没有 seed-level uncertainty、n 或 aggregation definitions，peak/delta、correlation 和 median 的稳定性难估计。
Figures 6/7/10/11/14 的 caption 过短，未完整定义 panel、颜色、阴影、指标范围或判据。
跨图颜色语义未完全冻结，Figure 9 存在 caption orange 与 rendered blue mismatch。
Table 4/5/9 的 block baseline、缩写、✓/✗ 和 P/G 需要正文回查，小字号降低可核验性。
Figure 12 的 trend/threshold 和 Figure 13 的 two-checkpoint straight paths 适合机制叙事，但计算规则和完整动态证据不足。
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: 先用 Figure 1 的二维概念图命名 entropy 的盲点，再用 MI proxy 与 SNR gradient decomposition 操作化它，以 RV/top-p pipeline、跨配置结果、补充 proxy 和显式 failure boundary 完成诊断—机制—干预闭环。
